findings.problem: Three pairs of declarations in `InfOffC1Geo` repeat the same argument, once for the finite chart and once for the infinite chart. The pairs are `chart_comm_fin`/`chart_comm_inf` (61–84), `isPullback_cFin`/`isPullback_cInf` (102–117) and `mem_range_cFin_iff`/`mem_range_cInf_iff` (124–148). The only differences are the names `ιFin`/`ιInf`, `chartAlgFin`/`chartAlgInf` and `ιFin_toBase`/`ιInf_toBase`. The proofs use nothing specific to either chart. They need only a ring `B`, a map `ι : Spec B ⟶ X` and the fact `ι ≫ toBase = Spec.map (algebraMap R B)`. The commutation proof (tensor-product `ext`, `simp`), the `IsPullback.of_right` plus `isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout` argument, and the `range_fst` / `isoPullback_inv_fst` argument are therefore written twice. The later lemmas `specializes_of_cFin`/`specializes_of_cInf` and `cFin_fst` etc. duplicate the statement-level pattern too.
findings.proposed_change:
Prove the three results once for a general chart. Take `B` with `[CommRing B] [Algebra R B]`, `ι : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ TwoChartIntegralModel R F j`, and `hι : ι ≫ toBase R F j = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))`. Define `cChart ι hι := pullback.lift _ _ (chart_comm ι hι)`. Prove `chart_comm`, `isPullback_cChart` and `mem_range_cChart_iff` for it, with the existing proofs where `ιFin_toBase` is replaced by `hι`.
Then set `cFin := cChart (ιFin R F j) (ιFin_toBase R F j)` and `cInf := cChart (ιInf R F j) (ιInf_toBase R F j)`, and obtain `isPullback_cFin`, `mem_range_cFin_iff`, `cFin_fst` and the open-immersion instance by `exact` / `simpa`. Do the same for `cInf`. `mem_range_cFin_or` is unchanged. The `specializes_of_c*` pair can likewise be one lemma stated for any open immersion `Spec.map` into a scheme.
findings.benefit: Roughly 60 lines of near-verbatim proof reduce to one generic version plus two one-line instantiations. A future fix, for example to the `IsPullback.of_right` argument or to the `rw` chain in `chart_comm`, is made once. The generic form also shows that nothing in the argument depends on which chart is used.
